Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 7  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that Eugene V. Debs was a member of the "Social Democratic Party of America." While Eugene V. Debs was indeed a prominent socialist, his primary political affiliation was with the "Socialist Party of America," not the "Social Democratic Party of America." This error occurred because the Planner failed to verify the specific political party associated with Debs after identifying him as the subject of *Adversary in the House*. The Planner prematurely marked the task as complete without fully validating the answer.
